table.chapter: Appendix X. Teng Shih K'ou District
table.title: Teng Shih K'ou District: Classification of Buildings and Population
table.context: Appendix X classifies the buildings (stores, residences, others, empty) and the population (men, boys, women, girls) of each hut'ung and street in the Teng Shih K'ou district, with the percentage of buildings that are residences.
transcriber_notes: Rows: 28 hut'ungs plus Total, as printed (table rotated 90 degrees on the page; read from rotated tight crops).
Houses: sum 1509, printed 1,509 -> reconciles
Stores: sum 493, printed 493 -> reconciles
Residences: sum 925, printed 925 -> reconciles
Others: sum 69, printed 69 -> reconciles
Empty: sum 22, printed 22 -> reconciles
Men: sum 5214, printed 5,214 -> reconciles
Boys: sum 772, printed 772 -> reconciles
Women: sum 1386, printed 1,388 -> DOES NOT reconcile
Girls: sum 572, printed 572 -> reconciles
Total: sum 7944, printed 7,946 -> DOES NOT reconcile
Printed em dashes (nil) kept as '—'. Dotted leaders omitted. Column heading 'Residences' is printed 'RESI-/DENCES'; 'Percent Residences' printed 'PERCENT RESI-/DENCES'.

Women column rows sum to 1,386 vs printed total 1,388, and Total column rows sum to 7,944 vs printed 7,946 (printed totals row itself: 5,214+772+1,388+572=7,946). Every individual row's men+boys+women+girls equals its printed Total and houses = stores+residences+others+empty in every row, so the 2 difference is a source discrepancy in the printed Women/Total totals; all cells kept as read.

F1 added: the 11 columns printed on the facing page 489 (image p0523, same rows, same order, rotated 90 degrees): Percent Male, Persons per House, Workers, Apprentices, Workers to One Apprentice, Buddhists, Confucianists, Mohammedans, Protestants, Catholics, No Report (the last three religion groups under the printed head 'Christians' for the Protestants/Catholics pair). Rows align one to one with page 488 (28 hut'ungs plus Total); each row now has 23 cells. The new columns are headed 'Religions — ...' by the transcriber as a grouping label; the page prints only the individual headings.

Totals of the added columns (sum of 28 rows vs printed Total row): Workers: sum 2008, printed 2,008 -> reconciles; Apprentices: sum 339, printed 339 -> reconciles; Buddhists: sum 365, printed 365 -> reconciles; Confucianists: sum 919, printed 916 -> DOES NOT reconcile; Mohammedans: sum 88, printed 82 -> DOES NOT reconcile; Protestants: sum 76, printed 81 -> DOES NOT reconcile; Catholics: sum 5, printed 8 -> DOES NOT reconcile; No Report: sum 11, printed 11 -> reconciles. Percent Male, Persons per House and Workers-to-One-Apprentice are ratios; their printed Total values (75.4, 5.26, 5.8) were not checked.
Em dashes (nil) kept as printed.

Religion columns that do not reconcile were re-read in 150% crops; all cells are clear, so they are kept as printed and the differences are taken to be in the source: Confucianists rows sum 919 vs printed 916; Mohammedans 88 vs 82 (Ta Tou Fu Hsiang is read 62); Protestants 76 vs 81; Catholics 5 vs 8. Workers, Apprentices, Buddhists and No Report reconcile.
Verified: an independent blind second transcription agreed on every cell; the totals that do not reconcile are as printed.
